hero.title: PRECISION CULINARY OPERATIONS
hero.subtext: 30 Years of Mastery. 6-Minute Execution. Private chef and catering service engineered for disciplined hospitality.

cards.title: Core Architecture
cards.description: Classical foundations translated into high-velocity production. Technique is the bedrock of efficiency, stripping away operational fluff to leave only precision execution.

cards.title: Precision Patisserie
cards.description: Baking demands exact chemical constraints. We apply this strict, zero-tolerance approach to every layer of the 47-&-SIX kitchen.

cards.title: Farm to Table
cards.description: Hyper-local supply chain integration. Direct sourcing optimizes flavor profiles and protects operational margins.

cards.title: World Cuisines
cards.description: Global flavor profiles engineered for modular deployment across catering and elite personal chef formats.

cards.title: Menu Management
cards.description: Menus built as scalable algorithms, maximizing profitability while seamlessly adapting to client dietary specifications.

cards.title: Cost Control & Purchasing Engine
cards.description: The 6-Minute Clock Cycle is our financial heartbeat. By locking production into rigid intervals, we eliminate operational drift, optimize purchasing yields, and maintain aggressive food cost controls. This is how quality scales without bleeding margin.

class_menu.title: CU222 Class Menu Portfolio
class_menu.tagline: Farm to Table to Kitchen course dishes, training progression, and plated examples from class and private chef development.
class_menu.story: Cooking started early at age 7, standing on a chair to reach the stove and learn from family. The kitchen standards are simple and strict: clean cook, safe cook, consistent cook. That ethic now powers both culinary school completion and the externship phase through a private chef and catering company.
